newsitem.title: INDIA: New Indian ministers to take oath on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: New Indian ministers to take oath on Wednesday.

text.p: Indian President Shankar Dayal Sharma will induct new members into Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's cabinet on Wednesday evening, the president's spokesman said.
The spokesman did not say how many new ministers would take the oath of office in the ceremony set for 7:30 p.m. (1400 GMT), nor who they would be.
P. Chidambaram and up to three other members of the Tamil Maanila Congress (TMC) party were expected to be sworn in, government officials said.
The TMC, which had tentatively decided to stay out of Gujral's government, announced earlier on Tuesday that it had changed its mind and would join his cabinet.
Chidambaram, who was finance minister under Gujral's ousted predecessor, H.D. Deve Gowda, was expected to return to the same post to pilot the 1997/98 (April-March) budget through parliament.
